patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a two-column grid with a prominent image on one side and text/CTAs on the other, alternating image placement for visual rhythm.
Key information and navigation are presented in card-like modules with subtle borders and imagery, such as locations and featured care areas.
A distinctive serif font is used for large, impactful headings, contrasting with a clean sans-serif for body text and subheadings to establish authority and readability.
A deep, authoritative blue serves as the primary brand color, used for backgrounds and key elements, powerfully contrasted by a bright, energetic yellow for calls to action and accents.
The navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and changing from a transparent overlay to a solid white background with a blue logo, while the hero content below it scrolls up.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, light gray, and deep blue) and full-width content blocks, creating a structured and organized flow down the page.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video or image background with a dark overlay, over which the main heading and calls to action are positioned to remain visually prominent as the background scrolls or plays.

The primary navigation implements a sticky effect where it transitions from a transparent, overlaid state to a condensed, solid-background state with a color-shifted logo once the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are designed to reveal dynamically as they enter the viewport, likely using a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation to introduce new information smoothly.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, authoritative serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clear, readable sans-serif body text, with uppercase sans-serif used for section labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and image corners, providing a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major content sections, creating a clear hierarchy, while internal card layouts maintain a more compact, organized rhythm.

standout: This site distinctively blends a highly authoritative and sophisticated brand presence, conveyed through deep blues and elegant serif typography, with a human-centered and empathetic approach, evident in its imagery and clear communication. The strategic use of a vibrant yellow accent against the deep blue creates a memorable and energetic visual identity that avoids feeling sterile.
